Package com.smu

Class TestMySQL

java.lang.Object
com.smu.TestMySQL
public class TestMySQL extends Object
Tests the MTC_Service_AppendOnly and MLDSA functions using an example implementation. This class serves as both a functional test suite and the source for automated Quick Start documentation snippets.

  • Method Details

    • clear_mysql_tables

      public static void clear_mysql_tables(String jdbcUrl, String dbUser, String dbPassword)
      Clears the MySQL pfs schema's certs/nodes/states tables before each test run, so this class can be re-run repeatedly like Test.java's SQLite-based clear_database_file() does. Unlike SQLite there is no database file to delete - the tables are provisioned externally and persist across runs/processes, so this opens its own short-lived JDBC connection (independent of MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL's own pool, which isn't constructed yet at this point) and just empties them.
      Parameters:
      jdbcUrl - JDBC connection string.
      dbUser - database username.
      dbPassword - database password.

    • gen_test_certs

      public static ArrayList<MTC_Cert_Record> gen_test_certs(int counter, int number, MLDSA mldsa, long create_time, long valid_time) throws Exception
      Generates a specified number of mock certificates for testing.
      Parameters:
      counter - The global certificate counter (starting index).
      number - The number of certificates to generate.
      mldsa - The MLDSA cryptographic handler instance.
      Returns:
      A list of newly generated MTC certificate records.
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error occurs during key generation or certificate issuance.

    • pem_print_helper

      public static void pem_print_helper(String pem)
      Prints a PEM string formatted as a JSON Array. This helper facilitates easy copying of PEM strings from the console into JavaScript environments for cross-platform testing.
      Parameters:
      pem - The raw PEM string (e.g., "-----BEGIN...").
